semiconductor_relevance: High — TKK is a well-established distributor of semiconductor equipment and materials, serving various sectors including PCB and optoelectronics.
summary: Taiwan Kong King, Co., Ltd. (TKK) specializes in distributing a wide range of equipment and materials for the semiconductor industry, including optical storage and PCB manufacturing equipment. They provide complete production line solutions and have a strong focus on advanced technologies in the PCB and semiconductor sectors.

regional_presence.Taiwan: TKK is based in Taiwan and serves the local semiconductor and electronics industries.
